name: ruleset
wording: the rules of one standard convention as the convention itself states them, under its own name, never a variant of it; offered together at install, taken whole or rule by rule; a project wanting a variant states it in its own files
reason: The operator: a known convention's name is never used for an alternative version of it; a ruleset aligns with the named convention, and a user who wants otherwise adds their own the standard way, in the project's own files.
